goals.title: Correctness & foundation
goals.objective: Fix .env-not-loaded (no-dep loader so npm start respects .env), fix options CALL/PUT misclassification, add browser User-Agent to Yahoo fetches, add SIGTERM/SIGINT graceful shutdown that drains connections and flushes pending writes, git init + baseline commit. check/test/smoke stay green.
goals.evidence: Commit d3f3cd2. src/env.js no-dep .env loader wired into config.js (verified secretKey now loads from .env). Options CALL/PUT fixed via calls/puts arrays. Yahoo browser User-Agent added to quote/chart/options. SIGTERM/SIGINT graceful shutdown + store.flush(). git init baseline 0aa62f8. npm run check + npm test (5/5 pass) + npm run smoke all green.

goals.title: Security hardening
goals.objective: Add security response headers (CSP for vanilla SVG/inline-style frontend, nosniff, frame-options, referrer-policy, permissions-policy, HSTS on secure), in-memory token-bucket rate limiting (strict auth keyed IP+email, looser API, 429+Retry-After), and Origin/Referer CSRF check on all mutating requests. Tests for limiter + csrf.
goals.evidence: Commit 580686b. src/security.js (CSP/headers, token-bucket limiter, clientIp+TRUST_PROXY, sameOriginOk CSRF) wired into server.js. 12 tests pass. Live-verified: headers present, evil-Origin=403, same-origin register=201, auth brute force=429 after 6.

goals.title: Caching & resilience layer
goals.objective: Add dependency-free in-memory TTL cache with stale-while-revalidate and single-flight de-duplication; wrap upstream quote/chart/news/fx fetches so parallel same-symbol calls collapse to one upstream request. Short TTL quotes, longer charts. Tests.

goals.title: Multi-currency FX normalization
goals.objective: Add fx module (Yahoo KRW=X live-ish + open.er-api/frankfurter fallback, cached); rewrite portfolio enrichment to convert each holding into base currency before summing (fixes USD+KRW raw-sum bug); separate capital gain from currency gain; add exposure-by-currency; surface base-currency totals + FX status in widgets. Tests for conversion math.

goals.title: Real-time streaming via SSE
goals.objective: Add multiplexed /api/stream Server-Sent Events endpoint with heartbeat and cleanup; server poller refreshes index/watchlist snapshot on interval via cache and pushes to subscribers; client EventSource with auto-reconnect, flash-on-update (respect prefers-reduced-motion), live connection-status badge; wire SSE into graceful shutdown.

goals.title: Price & indicator alerts
goals.objective: Implement alerts (settings.alerts schema exists): create/list/delete price-cross, percent-change, RSI-threshold alerts; evaluate client-side against live stream; fire Notification API + in-app toast; alert-center widget to manage/snooze/disable; persist per-user and in localStorage for guests.

goals.title: Crypto assets
goals.objective: Add crypto market module (Binance data-api primary, CoinGecko/Coinbase fallback, Coinbase for KRW pairs); route crypto symbols through snapshot/chart/watchlist with correct status labels; add crypto to market universe and a crypto monitor. Real responses only, no fake numbers.

goals.title: Economic & earnings calendar
goals.objective: Add calendar module (Finnhub earnings when key present else API-required, FRED US release dates, honest data-none/api-required labels for uncovered free tiers); calendar widget highlighting the user watchlist symbols.

goals.title: Terminal UX & accessibility polish
goals.objective: Command box autocomplete + history (up-arrow recall), global keyboard shortcuts + help overlay, multi-symbol comparison overlay with crosshair readout on the SVG chart, and accessibility baseline (never color-alone with arrows+signs, ARIA on data grids, visible focus, prefers-reduced-motion, contrast).

goals.title: Test coverage, CI & final gate
goals.objective: Broaden node:test coverage (marketData parsing, news sentiment, filings mapping, fx, cache, rate-limiter, brokers live-block safety); add GitHub Actions CI (check+test+smoke on Node 20/22); refresh docs/README. Run mandatory final gate: ai-slop-cleaner, verification, code-review; checkpoint complete only when all clean.
